story.iWant: to add subtle floating particles or ambient animation to my page
story.soThat: it creates atmosphere and visual interest
story.tasks: - Add particles, particle_style, particle_density, particle_color columns - Update shared schema with new fields - Create ParticleBackground component - Define styles for Dots, Stars, Sparkles, Bokeh - Add ParticleBackground to ArtistPage - Add UI controls to BackgroundEditor - Update EditorPreview - Test mobile performance

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Ambient Particles toggle in Background section AC2: When enabled, subtle particles float gently across background AC3: Style options: Dots, Stars, Sparkles, Bokeh AC4: Density options: Sparse, Normal, Dense AC5: User can select particle color (default: accent at 30% opacity) AC6: Mobile automatically reduces density for performance AC7: Respects prefers-reduced-motion AC8: Particles render behind content (proper z-index) AC9: Preview updates in real-time

dependencies.dep: No story dependencies - can start independently

constraints.constraint: Use CSS-only particle system for simplicity
Particles must be pointer-events: none to not block interaction
Must reduce particle count on mobile for performance
Z-index must place particles behind content

interfaces.interface: ParticleBackground({ enabled, style, density, color, accentColor }) - Renders floating particles with CSS animation - Density counts: sparse=15, normal=30, dense=50 (halved on mobile)

tests.locations: Manual visual testing, mobile device testing
tests.ideas: - Test all 4 particle styles - Test all 3 density levels - Test custom color selection - Verify mobile density reduction - Test prefers-reduced-motion - Verify z-index (particles behind content)
